newsitem.title: USA: Sovereign Bancorp sees Q4 net up 21 pct.
newsitem.headline: Sovereign Bancorp sees Q4 net up 21 pct.

text.p: Sovereign Bancorp Inc said Wednesday it expects earnings per share for the fourth quarter of 1996 were about $0.30 to $0.31, noting this is consistent with analysts' earnings estimates.
This would reflect an increase of 21 percent in net income for the fourth quarter of 1996 when compared with the fourth quarter of 1995 and about a 15 percent increase in EPS.
"This expected growth in fourth quarter operating earnings is consistent with our long-term stated vision," the comapny stated. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
